name: RANKS! KITS! PURE VANILLA
description:
REVIVE SMP!

A hardcore civilization world with Kingdoms, wars, and storylines, but all unscripted! Proximity text chat and voice chat, but that last one it optional ;). Also a revive mechanic where if the head you drop when you die, is placed on a pedestal , and the player is in spectator mode, they will be revived. Join today where spawn will be close to the most populated area of the server! (Discord coming soon and proximity VC coming soon)
